## About
Cres-O-matic Transmission is a family-owned and operated shop on Norwalk Blvd in Hawaiian Gardens. We focus on transmission repair and maintenance, and we have been doing it for decades for drivers across the greater Los Angeles area, from Long Beach and Lakewood to Cerritos, Downey and Seal Beach.
Bill, the owner, likes to explain what is actually going on with your car before any work starts. One reviewer wrote that his honesty and transparency really stood out, and another said he showed them the old part after the repair and talked through what was done.
We also sell transmission parts and accessories for people doing their own work, and we are members of the Automatic Transmission Rebuilders Association (ATRA) and the Automatic Transmission Service Group (ATSG). Rated 4.9 from 43 Google reviews.

## Services
- Transmission repair and maintenance: Diagnosis, repair and upkeep for transmissions. One reviewer had a major leak, had the car towed in, and got a call with updates along the way.
- Transmission parts and accessories: Working on your own vehicle? We carry a selection of transmission parts and accessories for do-it-yourself projects.
- Corporate service contracts: Businesses with vehicles can set up a service contract with the shop.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Give us a call and we can set up a free estimate.

Q: Is your work guaranteed?
A: Yes. All of our work is guaranteed. Ask us about the details when you come in.
